scope: Interpretazione documentata delle unità; nessuna verifica storica automatica delle quantità.

quotes: Kilobyte (K): 1 ,024 bytes.
128K of RAM, which can be expanded to 256 or 640K
c128-k.reason: Il glossario definisce K come 1024 byte, nel contesto della memoria C128. La normalizzazione usa KiB; non aggiunge né somma espansioni.

source.title: Amiga Hardware Reference Manual, 3rd edition — mappe di memoria

quotes: There are four basic models that make up the Amiga computer family: the A500, A1000, A2000, and A3000.
Memory space is the standard 8 megabyte space from $00200000-$009FFFFF.
amiga-map.reason: 0x009FFFFF − 0x00200000 + 1 = 8.388.608 byte = 8 MiB. La mappa del manuale dimostra la scala binaria usata per la memoria dei quattro modelli dichiarati. Non conferma automaticamente ogni dotazione/espansione già importata.
amiga-map.section: Appendice D, pp. 313–315; Zorro Expansion Bus, p. 387

source.title: BBC Master Reference Manual Part 1 — memoria e banchi

quotes: 128K of ROM, provided in the form of a ‘1 Mbit ROM’, and 128K bytes of 120ns Dynamic RAM
Paged ROMs always occupy locations &8000 - &BFFF
bbc-map.reason: Un banco ROM fra 0x8000 e 0xBFFF contiene 16.384 byte, cioè 16 KiB. Il manuale usa lo stesso K nei banchi RAM/ROM e nella descrizione di 128K della memoria Master.
bbc-map.section: F.1 CPU and associated memory; F.7 Paged ROMs

source.title: The Amstrad CPC Firmware Guide — SCR SET BASE

quotes: The screen memory can only be set at 16K intervals (ie &0000, &4000, &8000, &C000)
cpc-map.reason: Gli intervalli di 0x4000 byte sono 16.384 byte, chiamati 16K dal riferimento tecnico CPC. Questa è la scala binaria della memoria del sistema, non una deduzione dal nome del modello.

source.title: Atari 400/800 Technical Reference Notes — memory map

quotes: ADDRESS FUNCTION SIZE FFFF Operating System And Math Routines D800
LFFF RAM initially supplied in the product
atari-map.reason: La ROM OS/matematica occupa 0xD800–0xFFFF: 10.240 byte = 10 KiB. La RAM iniziale 0x0000–0x1FFF vale 8.192 byte e il limite 0xBFFF vale 49.152 byte (48 KiB). La riga OCR 2FFF/16K è discordante e non viene usata per attestare il massimo dell’Atari 400.

source.title: BYTE, febbraio 1984 — The Macintosh Memory Map, p. 40

quotes: After boot-up, the positions of RAM and ROM are changed so that the 128K-byte block of RAM occupies the first two pages of memory
mac-map.reason: La RAM Macintosh 128K va da 0x000000 a 0x01FFFF, escluso il confine 0x020000: 131.072 byte = 128 KiB. Non si confondono i 64K di ROM con la RAM.

source.title: MSX Technical Data Book — memoria di sistema

quotes: ROM: 32K bytes (MSX system software)
The BASIC ROM interpreter occupies addresses 0000 to 7FFF
msx1-map.reason: La ROM standard MSX1 di 32K byte occupa 0x0000–0x7FFF: 32.768 byte = 32 KiB. Un valore 32 Kb interpretato come kilobit sarebbe 4 KiB, incompatibile con quella ROM completa.

quotes: Standard ROM size is 48K bytes. The MSX ROM uses only 32K bytes.
Standard RAM size is 64K bytes
The RAM size of MSX1 varied from 8K to 64K bytes
A minimum of 64K bytes are required for VRAM
each 64K space is called a "slot", which consists of four 16K areas called "pages"
msx2-map.reason: Le pagine hanno confini 0x0000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0xC000: 16.384 byte ciascuna. ROM MSX2 = MAIN-ROM 32 KiB + SUB-ROM 16 KiB = 48 KiB. Per RAM/VRAM le dimensioni minime permettono di escludere una lettura in bit solo nei casi indicati nella singola regola; non si ricava la dotazione dal solo standard.

quotes: ** 64 KiB, of which 38 KiB were available for BASIC programs

! Address || Size
[KiB]
c64-iec.reason: La fonte dichiara RAM 64 KiB e una mappa in KiB. BASIC/KERNAL/character ROM occupano 8 + 8 + 4 KiB = 20 KiB.

quotes: | memory = {{unbulleted list|16–32 [[Kibibyte|KiB]] (Model A/B)|64–128 KiB (Model B+)|128 KiB (Master)|Plus 32–128 KB [[Read-only memory|ROM]], expandable to 272 KiB}}
bbc-iec.reason: La tabella usa esplicitamente KiB, compresi 128 KiB per la famiglia Master. Il chiarimento riguarda la memoria di base dichiarata, non eventuali coprocessori.

quotes: | memory = 512 or 1024 [[Kilobyte|KB]] 150 ns (maximum 9 to 138 MB, depending on upgrades){{efn|name=binpre|Here, K, M, G, or T refer to the [[binary prefix]]es based on powers of 1024}}{{efn|Using existing hardware, an A500 can be expanded by an internal CPU board with up to 128 MB like a [https://bigbookofamigahardware.com/bboah/product.aspx?id{{=}}67 DCE Viper 530], 8 MB external Fast RAM, and 2 MB Agnus expansion.}}
a500-binary.reason: La fonte dichiara esplicitamente che K/M/G/T sono prefissi binari basati su potenze di 1024. Il passaggio comprende la famiglia A500/A500+, non tutti i successivi Amiga.

quotes: The DECstation 3100 and 2100 uses a [[R2000 microprocessor|R2000]] processor, a R2010 floating point coprocessor and four R2020 write buffers. The R2000 uses an external 64 KB<ref>When used in the context of semiconductor memory, 1 KB refers to 2<sup>10</sup> (1,024) bytes and 1 MB refers to 2<sup>20</sup> (1,048,576) bytes</ref> direct-mapped instruction cache and a 64 KB direct-mapped write-through data cache with a cache line size of four bytes.<ref name="PMIN-PMAX"/> Four R2020 implement a four-stage write buffer to improve performance by permitting the R2000 to write to its write-through data cache without stalling.
dec-binary.reason: La nota della fonte definisce 1 KB = 1024 byte e 1 MB = 1.048.576 byte per la memoria a semiconduttori dell’articolo.

quotes: The '''PPC640''' was otherwise identical except that it had 640 [[kibibyte|KiB]] of memory, a built-in 2400 baud [[modem]] (unusually fast for its day), and its case was a darker shade of grey.  Both versions of the machine had an empty socket on the main circuit board so that an Intel [[8087]] coprocessor could be installed to permit hardware processing of floating point arithmetic.
ppc-iec.reason: La capacità PPC640 è riportata esplicitamente in KiB.

quotes: | memory = 16 to 48 [[KiB]] [[RAM]]
cp500-iec.reason: La fonte riporta RAM 16–48 KiB: i prefissi nella quantità già importata possono essere resi espliciti senza cambiare l’intervallo.

quotes: Like the Macintosh 128K before it, the 512K contained a [[Motorola 68000]] connected to 512 [[kilobyte|KB]] of [[Dynamic random-access memory|DRAM]] by a [[16-bit]] [[Bus (computing)|data bus]]. Though the memory had been quadrupled, it could not be upgraded. The large increase earned it the nickname '''Fat Mac'''. A 64 KB [[Read-only memory|ROM]] chip boosts the effective memory to 576 KB, but this is offset by the display's 22 KB [[framebuffer]], which is shared with the [[direct memory access|DMA]] video controller. This shared arrangement reduces CPU performance by up to 35%. It shared a revised logic board with the rebadged Macintosh 128K (previously just called the Macintosh), which streamlined manufacturing. The resolution of the display was the same at 512 × 342.
mac512-ratio.reason: La fonte descrive la RAM come quadrupla del Macintosh 128K: 4 × 131.072 byte = 524.288 byte = 512 KiB. La quantità non viene dedotta dalla sigla 512K.

quotes: The '''Macintosh 512K ''enhanced''''' ('''512Ke''') was introduced in April 1986 as a cheaper alternative to the top-of-the-line [[Macintosh Plus]], which had debuted three months previously.<ref>{{cite web| url=http://docs.info.apple.com/article.html?artnum=1970 |title=Macintosh 512Ke: Specifications (Discontinued) (8/94) |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110516051336/http://docs.info.apple.com/article.html?artnum=1970 |archive-date=16 May 2011 }}</ref>  It is the same as the [[Macintosh 512K]] but includes the [[Macintosh External Disk Drive#800K|800K disk drive]] and 128K of [[Old World ROM|ROM]] used in the Macintosh Plus. The new ROM supported [[Hierarchical File System (Apple)|HFS]] used on 800K and larger disks and allowed the [[Hard Disk 20]] to be used as a startup disk, doing away with the ''Hard Disk 20 Startup'' floppy required by the prior Macintosh 512K. Like its predecessors, the 512Ke has little room for expansion. Some companies did create memory upgrades to bring the machine up to 2 MB or more.
mac512ke-same.reason: La fonte dichiara la stessa macchina del 512K con modifiche a disco e ROM; la RAM resta 524.288 byte, mentre la ROM non è ricavata da questa equivalenza.
